rationale: On-disk feature caches contain zero same-source paired-fake feature vectors. The clip_vs_p8a_viso cache covers 131 / 1812 paired reals and 0 / 3499 paired fakes. The _features_cache_2026-04-30 caches store positional valid_idx without frame_path metadata and have no co-located sampling manifest locally. CE-only training on the existing 1100-frame fake/real-disjoint substrate cannot stress-test the pair-rank lever because there are no opposite-label same-source pairs to compute the rank loss against. The probe is structurally blocked at the data layer, not at the modelling layer.

recommended_followup.name: FROZEN_PAIR_FEATURE_EXTRACT_2026-05-07
recommended_followup.scope: Extract P8A, E2B (and optionally CLIP-B16 raw for baseline) frozen final-layer features for the 5311 unique frame_paths in pair_gap_audit_2026-05-06/outputs/pair_gaps.csv. After extraction, re-run THIS probe with the new cache.
recommended_followup.estimated_storage: ~50 MB combined (5311 × 512 dims × 4 bytes × 3 ckpts ≈ 32 MB plus metadata)
recommended_followup.blocking_decision: P1 encoder-FT in NEXT_STEPS_PLAN_2026-05-06 §8.2 should not launch before this probe returns a YES/NO on head-side signal. Spending GPU-weeks on encoder-FT when a frozen head-only retrain with pair-rank suffices would be a multi-day cost waste. Conversely, if the probe returns NO head-side signal, P1 is justified.

alternative_lever.name: PER_SUBSTRATE_TAU_CALIBRATION_LEVER_AVAILABLE_NOW
alternative_lever.summary: Job 7 result: 21pp lockbox recall lift available on P8A via per-substrate τ-calibration alone (no retraining required). This is a head-side OPERATING-POINT lever rather than a head-side WEIGHTS lever. It does not test the pair-rank weights hypothesis but it is deployable today and may close the gap that P1 was meant to close. Recommend a parallel scoping job alongside FROZEN_PAIR_FEATURE_EXTRACT_2026-05-07 to quantify the gap that pair-rank still has to bridge after τ-calibration.
